rule: An activity that no card grants is drawn for Admin only (the perms.isAdmin short-circuit in can.ts), so nobody else can reach it and no one-card login can test it. scripts/check-ungranted-activities.mjs fails on any activity+level listed nowhere here. Each record is a NAMED, DATED decision with its reason, never a count. A record whose activity is now granted fails the check until it is deleted. Admin itself is not a finding and is never given cards. foundNotRuled lists gaps the first run found that nobody has ruled on: printed every run as UNRULED, they do not fail the check, but a gap on neither list fails. It is EMPTY since 2026-11-12 (0360), when the last five of Lutan's fourteen rulings were built: four unused edit settings were removed from the catalogue, so those gaps no longer exist, and stock.usage went onto the food_forecast and medicine_forecast cards, so a card now grants it. A record must be deleted in the same change that closes its gap, because the check fails on a record whose gap is gone.

adminOnlyOnPurpose.reason: Moving an enclosure's plan is a rare, consequential act the shelter wants to stay with the administrator. Read is granted by cards; only edit is held by none.
Withdrawing a recorded death is rare and consequential; cards.ts keeps it off the residents card for exactly that reason.
